title: Implementation of Disposable Carrier Bag Charge and Impact on Lower-income Groups
what_it_is: Implementation of Disposable Carrier Bag Charge and Impact on Lower-income Groups

sections.label: Singapore disposables thrown away 2020
sections.summary: In 2020, about 200,000 tonnes of disposables were thrown away in Singapore, enough to fill 400 Olympic-sized swimming pools.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In 2020, about 200,000 tonnes of disposables such as carrier bags and takeaway containers were thrown away in Singapore, sufficient to fill 400 Olympic-sized swimming pools.

sections.label: Bag charges in other jurisdictions
sections.summary: Bag charges in Hong Kong, Ireland, the United Kingdom, Taiwan and the Netherlands reduced disposable bag consumption by about 60% to 90%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For example, bag charges in jurisdictions such as Hong Kong, Ireland, the United Kingdom, Taiwan and the Netherlands have reduced consumption of disposable bags by about 60% to 90%.

sections.label: No Plastic Bag initiative results
sections.summary: A year-long "No Plastic Bag" initiative at 25 supermarkets and convenience stores saved more than 15 million plastic bags.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Last year, their year-long "No Plastic Bag" initiative at 25 supermarkets and convenience stores resulted in more than 15 million plastic bags saved.

sections.label: Consulting supermarket operators on charge
sections.summary: Consultations with supermarket operators will cover home deliveries and training employees to minimise packaging use, aiming to finish by year end.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will also consult supermarket operators on other details, such as how the charge could apply to home deliveries and training supermarket employees, including those who pack groceries for deliveries, to minimise packaging use.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We aim to complete our consultations by the end of the year.

sections.label: Disposable bag charge supermarkets first
sections.summary: The disposable bag charge will start with supermarkets to develop a workable model before considering expansion to other retail outlets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Could I just ask whether while limiting the current disposable charge only to supermarkets, can we also explore other retail outlets, including the e-commerce platforms as well?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will only be looking into requiring a disposable bag charge in supermarkets to start with because we need to, first of all, develop a model that is workable and then, to look into the impact and any unintended consequences before we consider if this could be expanded further.

sections.label: 2018 SEC study plastic bags
sections.summary: An SEC study in 2018 found about 820 million plastic bags were taken from supermarkets, about 146 bags per person per year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: There was an SEC study in 2018, regarding the number of plastic bags that is taken out from the supermarkets; most people frequent supermarkets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I think in 2018, it was about 820 million, which is about 146 bags per person per year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have noted, charging for disposable carrier bags in supermarkets is not a silver bullet.

sections.label: Disposable carrier bag charge
sections.summary: The speaker says disposable carrier bag charges are being worked on, citing other countries and some retailers' positive response.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This is one way to also shift mindsets and behavioural change.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But I think we need to approach this from multiple fronts and we have seen other countries implementing disposable carrier bag charge as well as some of our retailers with positive response; and so we are actually working on this front now.
